name: Emerging Technologies for Environmental Management
description: Contemporary global and regional environmental issues; international treaties and institutional frameworks. Emerging contaminants and advanced monitoring tools (for example, AI, sensors, remote sensing). Innovative waste management strategies and circular economy. Nature-based solutions for pollution control and climate resilience. Environmental technology transfer models. Non-conventional and decentralized energy systems. Blockchain applications in emission trading and environmental governance. Case studies on integrated approaches to environmental management. Adaptation strategies to climate change.
